title: Analysis rejects unknown nested fields
requirement: Analysis Record не должен молча выбрасывать неизвестные nested-поля или превращать неверный contract enum в пустое значение. Пустые обязательные решения также недопустимы.
reason: Automated by the behavioral proof; the red run below is against the previous committed store bytes.
steps: Run the proof against the previous committed analysis/store bytes and observe unknown keys being accepted (red).
Call analysis_upsert with process.target:[{id,text}], decisions:[{id,text}] and with change:removed / an empty decision/rationale.
Assert invalid_record, findings[] paths decisions[0].text, process.target[0].text, decisions[0].decision/rationale and contracts[0].change, and the removed-to-breaking recommendation.
Assert the file bytes and rev are unchanged after every rejected call.
expected: Unknown nested keys reject with the exact path; change:removed is refused with a breaking+description recommendation; empty required decision/rationale is refused; no write and no rev change.
